# Pass map — what runs, in what order, on each convert path

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/pass_map.py. Do not edit by hand: tests/test_pass_map.py regenerates this and fails if it differs. -->

`src/nif_convert.py` defines **400** module-level functions and binds **283** flag/knob constants. The two entry points below are the whole conversion surface; `convert_nif` dispatches to `convert_nif_phase2` for a body-swap piece and otherwise runs the copy path itself.

Read the **Stage** column first: those are the checkpoints the survival trace measures (`CBBE2UBE_SURVIVAL_TRACE=1`), so they are the passes whose effect on the shipped mesh has actually been quantified. Everything else runs but is not per-shape traced. See `docs/PIPELINE.md` for what the labels mean.

**Guards** are the flag/knob constants in the `if` tests wrapping the call. A pass with a guard does not necessarily run.
